scope: Public application source and 48 authorized original portraits. Complete runtime and model weights are separate GitHub Release assets described by BUNDLE.json.

excluded_categories..git from private development: Never copied; public history begins with an independent initial source-release commit
excluded_categories..ai-data/**: Private settings, conversations, Story Memory and Session Journal
excluded_categories.local model weights and Ollama storage: Only the two public pinned base-model manifests/blobs and public character aliases are distributed as separate release assets; private aliases/storage are excluded.
excluded_categories..venv/** and node_modules/**: Reinstall from declared requirements and package lock
excluded_categories.__pycache__, caches, logs, test reports,: Generated/local paths and potential personal content
excluded_categories.historical docs/fork reports, screenshot: Excluded wholesale except curated technical hash manifests
excluded_categories..github/workflows/* and wrangler.jsonc: Original deployment/CI configuration excluded; no deployment authorized

private_exact_exclusion_manifest: Stored separately from the public source; do not publish private audit materials.
